QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Phantom's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Phantom again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Phantom's message is for #bEmpress Aria#k. Now you know why Phantom was angry. You avoided getting into any serious trouble, but how would Phantom feel about making a message he can't send?
